subject: Mythology
title: European Dragons: Fire and Terror
description: A 60-second lesson on European Dragons: Fire and Terror.

hook.text: In Europe, dragons are evil hoarders of gold who must be slain by heroes. In Asia, they are wise and divine.

buildup.text: European dragons breathe fire, guard treasure, and terrorize villages. They are the ultimate symbol of chaos and greed.

discovery.text: Saint George, Beowulf, and Sigurd all became legendary by killing dragons — the ultimate test of heroic courage.

twist.text: Some scholars believe dragon myths started when ancient people found dinosaur fossils and imagined them alive.

climax.text: From Smaug in The Hobbit to Drogon in Game of Thrones, European dragons dominate global fantasy to this day.

punchline.text: A creature that never existed became the most famous monster in all of fiction.

quiz.question: How do European dragons differ from Asian dragons?
options: European dragons are smaller and less powerful
European dragons are evil and must be slain; Asian dragons are wise and divine
European dragons live in water while Asian dragons live in mountains
